framing: Raw bytes include request line, all ordered headers, CRLF line separators, and the final CRLF CRLF delimiter.

comparison.firstChoice: Bind 127.0.0.1:54086 and compare the entire candidate request header block byte-for-byte.
comparison.fallback: If the captured port is already occupied, bind an ephemeral loopback port. Compare all bytes before and after the Host line verbatim; the sole permitted field value change is Host: 127.0.0.1:<actual-bound-port>.
comparison.contentLength: Never normalize Content-Length. It must match the actual candidate request body and the Native value when the body is byte-identical.
comparison.claim: Native-only raw header baseline. It does not claim candidate parity.
